title: Ulysses
author: James Joyce
summary: One ordinary day in Dublin in 1904, followed through the minds of an advertising canvasser, a young would-be writer and the canvasser's wife. Each chapter shifts style, from plain narration to parody to pure stream of thought.
readIf: you like language experiments and are willing to read with a companion guide and a lot of patience.
skipIf: you want a story that explains itself, or you are reading for plot rather than technique.

pairings.reason: Also compresses a whole life into a single day through a flowing inner voice, but is shorter and far easier to enter.
A modern book that plays with form just as boldly, with footnotes, shifting layouts and a deliberate dare to the reader.
An earlier landmark of comic, self-aware storytelling that rewards a reader who likes literary history.
